sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 240. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Increases wind elemental attack by 8 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies buff removal resistance, preventing karma or any buff removal effect one time.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 7000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 7000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 60 seconds.
Only [Raging Sandstorm] Seiran can be used as Unlocking Potential material
